programme.title: Same Time Next Week
programme.desc: When Christy meets Charlie, they discover that they have a lot in common than their lost spouses.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: Change of Heart
programme.desc: A TV producer decides to set a show at a bed and breakfast and bonds with the owner's son. But he becomes furious after learning one of her secrets.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date
programme.desc: A real-estate broker tasked with buying a community playhouse falls for the owner's daughter.

programme.title: Always a Bride
programme.desc: A woman lets loose during her bachelorette party in Las Vegas and wakes up married to a movie star, much to her fiancé's chagrin. Delays with an annulment further complicate matters, and the woman is left questioning which man is truly right for her.

programme.title: Straight From the Heart
programme.desc: A singles ad leads to an unlikely courtship between a Big Apple photographer (Teri Polo) and a widowed Wyoming rancher (Andrew McCarthy). Patricia Kalember, Greg Evigan. Carla: Christine Tucci. Howard: J. Kenneth Campbell. Jesse: David Jean-Thomas.

programme.title: Mystery Girl
programme.desc: A man (Sean Patrick Flanery) sends secret-admirer e-mails to his crush (Christine Scott Bennett), but an e-mail-address mix-up causes the notes to go to the woman's lovelorn coworker (Brigid Brannagh) instead. And though the man and his crush start dating, he can't help but feel a connection with the woman he'd been e-mailing. Directed by Allison Anders.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Love
programme.desc: A meteorology graduate student gets the opportunity to do the weather on a local TV-news show, where there's the potential for a full-time job and a possible romance with a co-worker.

programme.title: A Soldier's Love Story
programme.desc: A divorcée (Lori Loughlin) falls for a soldier (Johnny Messner) who has become a mentor to her son while home on leave. Despite their mutual attraction, the pair are hesitant to start a romance in light of the soldier's upcoming deployment overseas. Harvey Frost directed.

programme.title: Grand Champion
programme.desc: Stock heart-warmer about a preteen cowboy (Jacob Fisher) and his prize steer on a quest to win a prestigious cattle show in Texas. Joey Lauren Adams, Cache Williams. Written and directed by Barry Tubb, the film features cameos by Bruce Willis and Julia Roberts (whose husband, Daniel Moder, handles the cinematography), and country stars George Strait, Robert Earl Keen and Natalie Maines, of the Dixie Chicks.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.desc: A woman seeking romance finds an ideal man online, but she gets a surprise when she meets him and learns that his young son was posing as his dad and communicating with her.

programme.title: Mulligan
programme.desc: A kids-show actor (Ethan Erickson) and a single mom (Jennie Garth) butt heads after the two are in a car accident. But while dealing with the fallout from the crash, the pair begin to make a real connection. The actor's secrets, however, threaten to ruin the fledgling romance. David Burton Morris directed.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: James Garner stars as a retired judge whose cantankerous attitude is tempered by a troubled godchild (Norm Skaggs), a black tenant farmer (Bill Cobbs) who refuses the Medal of Honor and a blossoming romance. Judith Ivey. Rowena: Ruby Dee. Michael Waring: Larry Fishburne. Loreen: Jo Anderson. Judge Wesley: Wallace Wilkinson. Adapted from the novella by John William Corrington.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: Elevator Girl
programme.desc: An uptight lawyer (Ryan Merriman) and a free-spirited woman (Lacey Chabert) become trapped in an elevator together. The incident produces sparks between the two, but their different lifestyles threaten to ruin the romance before it gets off the ground. Patty McCormack, Hedy Burress and Jonathan Bennett also star. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.desc: March 25, 2006 Ruth Galloway is a well-to-do socialite who's not quite as secure inside as she seems from the outside. When a young woman named Billy saves her life, Ruth decides to turn her mansion into a shelter for the city's homeless.

programme.desc: A young nurse who takes a job as a live-in caretaker for a cantankerous, dying novelist discovers the secret of why the elderly woman is estranged from her son, and sets out to do something about it.

programme.desc: Newlyweds who are struggling with their relationship reconnect during a blackout, when their electronic devices are not working.

programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: The Secret Garden

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Tom Hiddleston, Brie Larson and Samuel L Jackson. A group of scientists and mercenaries are sent to a newly discovered Pacific island to investigate its unusual fauna. When their convoy is destroyed, the team faces a battle for survival against Skull Island's monstrous inhabitants - among them a certain giant ape.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Monster action adventure starring Rebecca Hall, Brian Tyree Henry and Dan Stevens. Since the Titans' last confrontation, Kong has decamped underground and is exploring the vast, fantastical world of "Hollow Earth". Meanwhile, Godzilla is up on the Earth's surface, keeping other monsters in check. However, a subterranean distress call initiates events that will see the two old foes face off against each other once again.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Decades on from the creation of Jurassic Park, a fully operational attraction filled with genetically engineered dinosaurs has been opened on the island. In need of a new attraction, the company behind the park creates an entirely new species - only for it to escape and terrorise the tourists. Action adventure sequel, starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Johnny Depp and featuring Freddie Highmore. Impoverished Charlie Bucket wins the last of five golden tickets hidden inside chocolate bars, entitling him to a guided tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious sweet factory. But it's an adventure that will have different results for all the children involved.

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Musical comedy prequel to Roald Dahl's Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, starring Timothée Chalamet. Young Willy Wonka yearns to produce his own confectionary, but finds trouble in the form of a shady cartel of chocolatiers and a mysterious thief.

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: Sci-fi action thriller starring Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke and Mark Rylance. In 2045, society's main entertainment is an ultra-immersive virtual reality simulation called the "OASIS". Its late creator, James Halliday, has hidden an Easter egg within the game that, if unlocked, will grant ownership to the finder. Teen gamer Wade Watts is determined to win the prize, but he has lethal competition in the form of Halliday's ruthless business rival Nolan Sorrento.

programme.title: Snow White & the Huntsman
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth and Charlize Theron. Snow White is on the run from her evil stepmother who has sent a group of men into the woods to capture her. But the huntsman leading the search learns that he is also a victim of the Queen's duplicity and aims to protect the girl - even if she seems quite capable of looking after herself.
